summary_en: This Nature Portfolio paper applies a custom high-resolution transmission-mode photoacoustic microscopy system to 3D bioprinted tumor–vessel constructs. The system provides depth-resolved volumetric visualization and quantification of vascular maturation and anti-cancer treatment response, with an approximately 1.6-fold larger 1/e^2 penetration depth than confocal microscopy and imaging across roughly 1 mm of the construct. Because the work directly uses and characterizes photoacoustic image formation for deep 3D biological imaging, it is a core repository addition rather than a downstream-only analysis paper.
